ROUND 1 security PASS for PR #259 at d4ed02aabdb7989508f3205307ded9927f76a694.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | No vulnerabilities found | - |

The security-review specialist returned PASS after a bounded static review covering installed-CLI SDK/module resolution and symlinks, the Node resolution hook, process argument handling and inherited environment, credential/daemon access boundaries, and current-head public-source/JSON/docs/PR-body privacy. No introduced exploitable module/path injection or credential/privacy vulnerability was found. C33 applies: same-user control of installed SDK files, repository files and environment is trusted; the canary is not a sandbox.

Validation: just pr-freeze 259 returned FINAL at the exact head, with CLEAN merge status, main base, ready status, unchanged migration numbering and passing CI check (22), check (24), rust-lint, rust-test and Delivers. The detached review worktree was clean.

Live canary: /usr/bin/nice -n 19 just copilot-sdk-contract exited 0, reporting all seven tool/hook/session-event checks passing on Copilot 1.0.114-0. The tool handler returned the expected identity-not-ready response rather than sending a real message. --record was not used. target/ was absent before and after; git status remained clean. Existing dependencies were used; no dependency installation, build or cargo command was run.

Known limits: this is a security-only verdict with static inspection plus the real-SDK registration canary, not a credential-file-access trace, future-SDK guarantee or live-fleet cost measurement.
